sources.claim: MITRE ATT&CK says Ryuk shares code similarities with Hermes ransomware.
Check Point reports Ryuk's encryption logic and inner workings connect it to Hermes and suggest access to Hermes source code or code reuse.
McAfee Labs agrees Ryuk actors had access to Hermes source code and describes Ryuk as likely an altered Hermes 2.1 version.
CERT-FR/ANSSI describes Ryuk as a Hermes 2.1 variant while noting remaining uncertainty about Ryuk's exact origins.

curator_note: Modeled as code sharing instead of direct derivation because sources strongly support Hermes/Ryuk code continuity, but exact actor ownership and development path remain partly uncertain.
confidence_reason: MITRE, Check Point, McAfee, and CERT-FR/ANSSI independently support code or source-code continuity between Ryuk and Hermes.
